```{r, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning=FALSE)
# plotly.js from the CDN, so the site's pages don't each copy it
options(plotly.core.plotlyjs = "cdn")
```
#### Basic Inset

See also the [subplots page](subplots.html) for laying out several plots with `make_subplots()`.

```{r}
library(plotly.core)

fig <- go_figure() |>
  add_scatter(x = c(1, 2, 3), y = c(4, 3, 2), mode = "lines") |>
  add_scatter(
    x = c(20, 30, 40),
    y = c(30, 40, 50),
    xaxis = "x2",
    yaxis = "y2",
    mode = "lines"
  ) |>
  update_layout(
    xaxis2 = go_xaxis(domain = c(0.6, 0.95), anchor = "y2"),
    yaxis2 = go_yaxis(domain = c(0.6, 0.95), anchor = "x2")
  )

fig
```
